The test class is `TestAddressBuilding` in `tests/test_aids.py`, starting at line 102. It tests `quill.build_link_to`, which is Quill's `url_for`. Its methods are:

- `test_link_for_with_fragment` (line 103) covers anchors. It checks that `build_link_to("index", _anchor="x y")` returns `/#x%20y`.
- `test_link_for_with_protocol` (line 110), `test_link_for_with_protocol_not_outside` (line 120) and `test_link_for_with_swapping_protocols` (line 131) cover schemes. They exercise `_scheme="https"` together with `_external=True` and `_external=False`.
- `test_link_with_verb` (line 143) covers HTTP methods. It uses `_method="GET"` and `_method="POST"` on a view registered with different rules per method. The checks include `/myview/`, `/myview/42` and `/myview/create`.
- `test_link_for_with_this` (line 164) is another method in the same class. I didn't read its body.

The tests use the `app` and `qry_scope` fixtures. The code under test is `helpers.build_link_to` (`src/quill/helpers.py`, lines 188-239), which forwards to `App.build_link_to` in `src/quill/app.py` (around lines 1003-1127).
